prompt:
Educational caricature comic strip, ${subject_topic}, humorous and cute style, set on textured vintage paper background. 

Language Constraint: All text within the image must be written strictly in ${target_language}.

Header: Stylized red pencil banner at the top containing ${target_language} text "${keyword_text}", large bold ${target_language} title "${main_title}". 

Layout: Two framed panels side-by-side. 
- Left Panel: ${target_language} label "${left_panel_label}", ${scene_description_1}, expressive character, charming cartoon style. 
- Right Panel: ${target_language} label "${right_panel_label}", ${scene_description_2}, funny reaction, highly detailed. 

Bottom Section: Three lines of ${target_language} narrative text: "${narrative_1}", "${narrative_2}", "${narrative_3}". 

Aesthetics: Decorated margins with cute illustrations of ${decoration_theme}, professional comic ink, flat vibrant colors, wholesome mood, clean composition, 4k, charming expressive cartoon style. [@YOURUSERNAME] at bottom center.
improvedPrompt:
Improved prompt:

Create a humorous, cute, and highly detailed educational comic strip focused on the topic of ${subject_topic}, set against a textured vintage paper background. The comic must be designed in a stylish, charming cartoon style that appeals to young learners.

Language Constraint: Every single word of text within the comic, including all speech bubbles, labels, and narrative captions, must be written strictly in proper and grammatically correct ${target_language}.

Header Design:
- At the very top, incorporate a stylized red pencil banner that spans the entire width of the comic. This banner should contain the text "${keyword_text}" in a bold, eye-catching ${target_language} font.
- Beneath the banner, include a large, bold ${target_language} title "${main_title}", positioned centrally and in a font that harmonizes with the banner.

Comic Layout:
- The comic should consist of two framed panels arranged side-by-side, each panel having its own unique label in ${target_language}.

Left Panel:
- Label: "${left_panel_label}"
- Scene Description: ${scene_description_1}
- Visual Requirements:
  - Feature a central character in a highly expressive pose that captures the mood of the scene.
  - Use a charming, whimsical cartoon style that is both educational and entertaining.
  - Maintain a consistent color palette that complements the vintage paper background.

Right Panel:
- Label: "${right_panel_label}"
- Scene Description: ${scene_description_2}
- Visual Requirements:
  - Depict a humorous reaction or exaggerated expression from the character in the panel.
  - Include highly detailed elements that enhance the educational content and visual appeal.
  - Maintain the same color scheme and style as the left panel.

Bottom Section:
- Below the panels, include a three-line narrative text box written entirely in ${target_language}. The text should be "${narrative_1}", "${narrative_2}", and "${narrative_3}", respectively.

Artistic Aesthetics:
- Decorate the margins of the comic with cute illustrations that align with the theme of ${decoration_theme}. The illustrations should complement the vintage paper background and enhance the overall visual appeal.
- Use professional comic inking techniques to ensure the lines are clean and the details are crisp.
- Apply a flat, vibrant color palette that is inviting to young readers. The colors should be chosen to create a wholesome, engaging mood.
- Maintain a clean, well-composed layout that balances the visual elements and text effectively.
- Ensure the final artwork is rendered at a resolution of 4k or higher, providing ample detail for close-up viewing.
- Include the artist signature "[@YOURUSERNAME]" centered at the bottom of the comic, written in a small, distinctive font.

The goal of this comic is to entertain while educating young minds about the complexities of ${subject_topic}, all while maintaining a high level of artistic quality and a professional, polished presentation.
